# The Neural Link client never dispatches set_neo_config

## Context

Hit live on 2026-09-04 (~13:05Z) while arming hot patching for the D#18224 popup-birth arm: `manage_neo_config` with `action: 'set'` returned `Unknown method: set_neo_config`. Worked around from the page with `Neo.worker.App.setGlobalConfig({enableHotPatching: true})`. Both sides verified at `dev@2ee23d7801` and Brain `ea336dd`:

- the Brain's Neural Link server forwards the `set` action as the JSON-RPC method `set_neo_config` (`ai/services/neural-link/RuntimeService.mjs:103`);
- the engine client implements it — `src/ai/client/RuntimeService.mjs:631` `setNeoConfig({config})` — but its dispatch table `src/ai/Client.mjs:156–171` registers `get_neo_config: runtime` and no `set_neo_config`; `handleRequest` (`:243–248`) resolves the service by `method.startsWith(prefix)` over that table, finds none, and throws at `:266`.

A handler that exists and cannot be reached is the defect; the tool advertises a capability the runtime refuses.

## The Fix

Add `set_neo_config: runtime` to the dispatch table beside `get_neo_config`. Pin the contract: a unit spec drives `Client#handleRequest` with every snake_case method the Brain forwards for the runtime service (the list in the spec, sourced from the Brain's `openapi.yaml` operationIds at review time) and asserts each resolves to a function — red-first for `set_neo_config`.

## Contract Ledger Matrix

| Target Surface | Source of Authority | Proposed Behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.ai.Client#serviceMap` (`Client.mjs:156`) | Brain `openapi.yaml` `manage_neo_config` (`action: set`) | `set_neo_config` dispatches to `RuntimeService#setNeoConfig` | `Unknown method` error (unchanged for unmapped names) | `RuntimeService#setNeoConfig` docblock already states the contract | `manage_neo_config set` followed by `get` shows the written value |

## Decision Record impact

`none`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `manage_neo_config` `action: 'set'` reaches `RuntimeService#setNeoConfig`; a following `action: 'get'` returns the written key (live check on any app with the Neural Link enabled).
- [ ] Unit, red-first: `handleRequest('set_neo_config', {config: {…}})` today throws `Unknown method`; after the fix it resolves.
- [ ] The dispatch-completeness spec above passes for the runtime service's full method list.

## Avoided Traps

- Do not add a `set_` prefix catch-all: prefix matching is how `get_dom_event*`, `get_drag*`, `get_window*` families are grouped deliberately (`:159–165`); one exact key is the fix.
- Do not move the enable-hot-patching workaround into docs as a recipe; the tool is the contract.
